scope: Free flight-data discovery over a complete prepared UTC day. No recording clock, recording date, video or known camera position was supplied. This is a coverage diagnostic; it does not establish video location accuracy.
defect: Sample discovery selected aircraft only inside observer bounds. The flight reader retained positions beyond those bounds, so automatic preparation omitted useful nearby flights.
selection_rule: Use the existing flight importer area: 0.6 degrees beyond latitude bounds and 0.6 / max(abs(cos(latitude)), 0.05) degrees beyond longitude bounds. Accept valid source coordinates only. No generated positions or speed extrapolation.
remaining_coverage_gap: Aircraft can still pass through the reference area between five-minute snapshots.

speed_reach_diagnostic.scope: Separate offline experiment; not applied to the application. Recorded ground speed and source observation time were used to select possible crossings between snapshot cells. No positions were generated.

duplicate_reference_attempt.scope: Ten newly downloaded airborne traces were byte-identical to files in the earlier manual reference. Two additional ground-only identities produced no exported tracks.

initial_ci_failure.failure: The damaged legacy cache was rejected, but the error omitted the Offline mode marker.
initial_ci_failure.repair: Restore the offline error marker without weakening integrity checks or changing the test.
initial_ci_failure.local_qualification: Stopped after the same source failed CI; only verified compiler children of that qualification job were terminated. Logs and terminal owner receipts were retained.
